'''servant76 Sith Revenge''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[servant76]]
* '''Published:''' 14 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Let Them Make The First Move
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 FirstMove servant76 DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Standard DS Lightsaber Combat

The published list has 61 cards.
